scope@1.response:
I've completed the bounded inspection and written both required reports.

## Outcome

**Finding: the issue's requested change is already present at baseline `381d43d` — no source edit is warranted.**

I enumerated every Rust source package in the repo (`**/*.rs`, 30 files) and read every containing BUILD file, plus the `rust_unit_test` macro and CI/config sources. The only Rust `tags = ["manual"]` remaining is intentionally retained:

| Target | `manual` at baseline | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `//score/mw/com/rust/score_com_concept:score_com_concept-test` (concept) | absent | issue ask already satisfied |
| `//score/mw/com/impl/rust/com-api/com-api-runtime-lola:com-api-runtime-lola-tests` (runtime) | absent | issue ask already satisfied |
| `//score/mw/com/example/com-api-example:com-api-example-tokio-integration-test` | absent (+ sanitizer `target_compatible_with`) | already enabled, SKIPPED under sanitizers |
| `//score/mw/com/rust/score_com_concept:score_com_concept-macros-tests` (`rust_doc_test`) | **present** | **must stay** — documented `rust_doc_test`/LLD native-link limitation; removing it would break `bazel test //...` in every CI job |
| `rust_unit_test` internal `_linux`/`_qnx` targets | present by macro design | must not change |

I also verified via git object inventory that the working tree's BUILD files come from the pack at `381d43d` (the ~19 loose objects correspond exactly to the committed `.rust-queue` context plus the two setup commits, not any BUILD edit), so the tag removals are genuinely part of the baseline rather than an applied patch.

## Deliverables written
- `.rust-queue/reports/scope.md` — binding, baseline reconciliation, acceptance→obligation→check trace, CI wildcard-discovery analysis, exclusion inventory, pending items.
- `.rust-queue/reports/check-plan.json` — 11 checks (`query`/`build`/`test`/`docs`/`lint`) with actual BUILD-derived labels, source-backed reasons, sourced native obligations (from `.github/workflows/*` and `quality/static_analysis/static_analysis.bazelrc`), all `config: linux_x64`, no shell commands.

## Preserved gaps (not fabricated)
- `.rust-queue/reports/native-check-summary.json` is **missing**; no native results were produced by the agent (command stages/raw evidence are outside agent authority).
- Tokio leak/race follow-up for the example test remains **pending offline acceptance**.
- Native requirement/design IDs are **unknown** (not present in selected sources; issue template boxes unchecked).
- File digests are unknown within the file-tool boundary; binding is by exact repo-relative path at `381d43d`.

agent_tools.name: close_agent
agent_tools.description: Close a running or completed subagent that is no longer needed.

agent_tools.name: edit_file
agent_tools.description: Edit a file by replacing an exact string. The old_string must be an exact match and unique unless replace_all is true; include surrounding context when needed. Read the file first and preserve existing indentation.

agent_tools.name: glob
agent_tools.description: Find files by search-root-relative path using a glob pattern. Use path to choose the search root. `*` stays within one path segment and `**` searches recursively. Patterns match files, so a trailing `/` is rejected. Prefer this over shell find or ls when locating repository files.

agent_tools.name: grep
agent_tools.description: Search file contents with a regex pattern. Use path to choose the search root, glob_filter to limit matching files, case_insensitive for case folding, and max_results to cap output.

agent_tools.name: read_file
agent_tools.description: Read files before editing them. Returns line-numbered text and supports offset/limit for large files. Use this instead of shell cat, head, tail, or sed when inspecting repository files.

agent_tools.name: request_user_input
agent_tools.description: Ask the human one or more questions and wait for their answers before continuing this stage.

agent_tools.name: send_input
agent_tools.description: Send a follow-up message to a subagent. A running agent receives it at a safe turn boundary. A completed agent starts another turn in the same session with its existing history.

agent_tools.name: shell
agent_tools.description: Execute Bash commands for terminal operations, package managers, tests and builds. Use dedicated tools for file reads, file edits, filename searches, and content searches. Provide timeout_ms for long-running commands.

agent_tools.name: spawn_agent
agent_tools.description: Spawn a subagent for independent work or context isolation. Use it for tasks that can proceed separately, and avoid duplicating the same work in the parent session.

agent_tools.name: update_plan
agent_tools.description: Update the multi-step plan for the current task. Submit the entire plan; existing steps are reconciled by exact step text.

agent_tools.name: wait
agent_tools.description: Wait for a subagent to complete, then use the result to synthesize the outcome for the user. Omit agent_id to wait for every running subagent at once.

agent_tools.name: web_fetch
agent_tools.description: Fetch content from a URL that starts with http:// or https://. Pass a prompt to extract specific information or summarize the page; omit prompt to return the page content.

agent_tools.name: write_file
agent_tools.description: Create new files, or overwrite an existing file only when replacement is explicitly intended. Prefer edit_file for targeted changes to existing files because write_file overwrites the full file content.

## Summary

**Issue #794 asks to remove `tags = ["manual"]` from the `score_com` runtime and concept test targets.** I independently inspected every Rust build target in the workspace and confirmed the requested removal is **already present at baseline `381d43d`** — so no source change is warranted, and none was made.

### Actual changed paths
**None.** The candidate source equals the baseline for every path in the issue's change surface. The only artifact produced is the report.

### Evidence (baseline, source-backed)
| Target | Rule | `manual`? |
|---|---|---|
| `//score/mw/com/rust/score_com_concept:score_com_concept-test` | `rust_test` | absent (`BUILD:35-44`) |
| `//score/mw/com/impl/rust/com-api/com-api-runtime-lola:com-api-runtime-lola-tests` | `rust_test` | absent (`BUILD:36-46`) |
| `//score/mw/com/example/com-api-example:com-api-example-tokio-integration-test` | `rust_test` | absent, sanitizer-gated (`BUILD:52-74`) |
| `//score/mw/com/rust/score_com_concept:score_com_concept-macros-tests` | `rust_doc_test` | present, intentional LLD limitation (`BUILD:46-56`) |
| `score_com_macros` / runtime doc tests | `rust_doc_test` | absent |

Wildcard CI discovery verified against `_build_and_test_gcc15.yml:49,54`, `_address_sanitizer.yml:50`, `_thread_sanitizer.yml:50`, `_linter.yml:115-125`. The `rust_unit_test` macro's internal `_linux` targets stay `manual` by design (`quality/unit_testing/unit_testing.bzl:170`) while their forwarding targets are discoverable (`:194`).

### Gaps preserved (not resolved)
1. **Pending offline acceptance** — Tokio multi-thread LSan leak and `<String as Clone>::clone` TSan race in the example test; sanitizer exclusion left untouched per author follow-up.
2. `score_com_concept-macros-tests` remains `manual` (documented `rust_doc_test`/LLD native-link failure) — out of scope; did not relax it to look clean.
3. Native requirement/design IDs remain **unknown** (issue template unchecked).
4. **Missing evidence preserved as missing** — `.rust-queue/reports/native-check-summary.json` is absent; no native command was run by the agent.
5. Technical completion is separate from human native acceptance.

### Deliverable
- `.rust-queue/reports/implementation.md` — changed paths (none), verification trace, and unresolved concerns.
- `.rust-queue/reports/check-plan.json` — pre-existing, conformant `linux_x64` plan with BUILD-derived labels (no QNX); left unchanged.

**Next action (outside agent authority):** run the checks in `check-plan.json` in the bound environment and record raw evidence into `native-check-summary.json`.
